description: This file defines TypeScript interfaces, types, and a class for interacting with the GitHub API, specifically for managing deployments and commits via the '@actions/github' library.

classes.name: OctokitGitHubApi
classes.description: A class implementing the GitHubApi interface, providing methods to create deployments, deployment statuses, list deployments, and get commit details using the '@actions/github' library.

methods.name: getCommit
methods.description: Fetches commit details from GitHub given owner, repo, and ref or SHA.

methods.name: createDeployment
methods.description: Creates a new deployment on GitHub with specified parameters.

methods.name: createDeploymentStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a deployment on GitHub.

methods.name: listDeployments
methods.description: Lists deployments for a specific repository and commit SHA.
